capabilities: load font files from a vault folder without network requests
assign families to text, interface, monospace, headings and emoji roles
declare variable fonts across their full weight range
pick per-device builds of multi-format emoji fonts
diagnose per-family coverage and check assigned font loading on the current device
extras: Warns that Obsidian Sync excludes hidden folders, so a dot-prefixed fonts folder stays device-local unless synced another way.
problem: Obsidian's font settings only offer fonts already installed on the operating system, so vault-specific font files cannot be used and do not sync with the vault.

relations.evidence: BRAT does the same thing and keeps it updated from this repository.

summary: Font loader that reads .ttf, .otf, .woff and .woff2 files from a vault folder and lets you assign them to text, interface, monospace, headings and emoji.
